Jo (Design): quick drop: compact 'token peek' bar mock for small screens. shows total tokens, per-message badge, and a tiny scrubber to inspect recent chunks. mock: https://figma.redwood/proto/token-peek-mini :mag:

Lina (Product): looks useful. q: does scrubbing pause streaming or just freeze UI?

Jo (Design): freeze UI only by default (no backend cancel). tapping Freeze will let you inspect without losing partial text. we’ll add an explicit Abort to stop compute.

Ravi (Eng): implementation notes: keep streaming updates to a single text node. maintain a ring buffer of last ~20 chunk metas for the scrubber. token estimates update on chunk boundaries (batch 1s).

Taylor (DevEx): keyboard flow: composer -> send -> token-peek. Scrubber needs arrow-key support and an entry in the command palette: I = Inspect, F = Freeze, A = Abort.

Noor (A11y): accessibility: mark the region role=region aria-label="Token information". Scrubber must announce chunk index and estimated tokens: e.g., "chunk 3 of 8, ~24 tokens". limit live announcements to start/completion to avoid flooding.

Lina (Product): copy: Freeze vs Interrupt naming? analytics want distinct events: playground.freeze and playground.abort. we prefer Freeze for UI-only action.

Jo (Design): copy options for scrubber hover: A) "Drag to inspect recent response chunks and estimated token cost" B) "Inspect recent chunks — drag or use arrow keys" C) "View token cost for recent text". team lean: B.

Ravi (Eng): perf checklist: single-node streaming updates, token counter updates every 2s, scrubber gesture debounce 50ms, retain metadata for last 20 chunks.

Taylor (DevEx): QA: add e2e for keyboard scrubbing, SR narration for Freeze/Abort, and analytics events. include shortcuts in the help modal.

ui-deploy: scheduling experiment rollout: playground/compact-token-peek -> internal beta 2024-07-05T16:00:00Z :rocket:

Jo (Design): will upload updated frames with aria labels and a short gif of Freeze -> Inspect -> Abort. tagging PR ux/compact-token-peek when ready. :white_check_mark:
